standard_prerequisites.name: Etale dominates smooth
standard_prerequisites.use: Lets V be replaced so that V -> U exists.

core_obligations: Set up the adjoint map g_!O' -> O from the identification O' = g^{-1}O, describe g_!O' by the colimit presheaf formula and the action on elements (proof lines 3030-3065).

Surjectivity: for h in O(V), use a surjective smooth U -> X in C' and the etale-dominates-smooth lemma to assume V -> U exists; the A^1 trick produces (V -> U x A^1, t) in the colimit mapping to h (proof lines 3068-3083).

Injectivity: reduce a finite sum of colimit elements to a single (phi, s) via the fibre product over U with a surjective etale W in C'; force the vanishing locus Z of s to be smooth (resp. flat) by the U x A^1 replacement; then (V -> Z, 0) equals (phi, s) in the colimit, so s is zero (proof lines 3086-3124).
proof_roadmap: Describe g_! by its colimit formula and the adjoint map.
Surjectivity via the A^1 trick; injectivity via reduction to a single term and the smooth vanishing locus.
difficulty_reason: Ninety-seven line direct computation with the g_! colimit formula: surjectivity uses the A^1 trick (V -> U x A^1 with the coordinate t) after an etale-dominates-smooth replacement; injectivity reduces finite colimit sums to a single term by a fibre product with a surjective etale W, then kills the section by replacing U with U x A^1 so that the vanishing locus becomes smooth (resp. flat), where the colimit identifies (V -> Z, 0) with (phi, s).
